units.title: Program Comparison Engine
units.description: WEDMProgramComparisonEngine: parses reference NC + generated NC via WireEDMProgramParserEngine, compares 9 WEDM-specific dimensions (dialect, pass count, offset cascade, feed cascade, E-code family, taper, adaptive control, safety block, contour moves), outputs per-parameter deviation report + weighted overall_match + production_ready gate (≥85% AND no criticals).

units.title: Deviation Dashboard Panel
units.description: WireEdmCalibrationPanel.tsx: Calculator-Studio-styled React panel that consumes WEDMComparisonReport and renders hero match gauge, per-parameter deviation bars with severity chips, optional history sparkline, and Calibrate/Re-compare action buttons. Pure presentational — host page owns state.

units.title: Tighten Benchmark Tolerances
units.description: WEDMBenchmarkToleranceEngine + WEDM_BENCHMARK_TOLERANCES.json config file: single source of truth for all WEDM tolerance bands. v2 tightens area ±30%→±20%, kerf ±20%→±15%, finish ±70%→±30%, D2 speed ±70%→±25%, offset cascade ±30%→±25%. WEDMCalibrationReportEngine re-wired to consume via roughSpeedBandFor() and getBand() — no more inline magic numbers.

units.title: Final Production Readiness Score
units.description: Run full validation suite, generate WEDM_FINAL_READINESS.json with overall score (target: 90+), per-dimension scores, calibration confidence
